title: Review finding clarification: IID validation not in NodeChannel
description:
Finding 1 from code review suggests adding IID length boundary tests to test_node_channel.py, but this is not applicable:

- node_channel.py lines 205-210 explicitly state 'No IID check here' in a SECURITY comment
- IID validation happens at the link layer (Node), not in NodeChannel
- The sender.iid attribute is never accessed in node_channel.py
- Multi-hop routing requires accepting packets where link-layer sender IID differs from IPv6 source

The existing test_node_channel_accepts_multihop_packets already verifies this design decision.

No code change needed - this is a false positive finding for this file.
